node.statement: Apply lem-stage1-polar-retraction-transport to the receiving tuple W, using P<=C_pol, 0<kappa_pol<=rho and the retraction smallness guard from 1.2. For the very map displayed in the root, Pi_delta:calU x B_delta^{calH}(J)->S_delta, Pi_delta(U,H)=U bold-dot H, this gives a C^1 diffeomorphism onto S_delta, with unique inverse (u_delta,h_delta), the identities X=u_delta(X) bold-dot h_delta(X), u_delta(U)=U and h_delta(U)=J, and the inclusion calU_{delta-C_pol*r} subseteq S_delta.
